Ishita Kapoor
Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist | Kolkata
ishita.kapoor345@example.com | +91 9437333219

Experienced talent acquisition professional focused on high-volume and specialized hiring across IT and consulting domains. Combines structured sourcing via LinkedIn Recruiter and ATS-driven processes in Workday with data-informed outreach to reduce time-to-fill and improve quality of hire. Strong cross-functional collaborator with payroll coordination experience and familiarity with Agile team environments.

Experience

Capgemini — Jun 2025 - Present
Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist
Work mode: Hybrid
- Led end-to-end Recruitment for cloud and digital practice roles, using LinkedIn Recruiter to source 150+ screened candidates and convert 28 hires in the first 6 months, reducing average time-to-fill by 22%.
- Managed candidate pipeline and offer workflows in Workday, maintaining 95% accuracy in requisition updates and enabling weekly hiring-status reporting to stakeholders.
- Partnered with hiring managers in Agile squads to define role profiles and prioritize backlog hires, resulting in a 30% faster ramp for new joiners.
- Coordinated pre-onboarding payroll data with HR/payroll teams to ensure 100% timely documentation for new hires and a smooth payroll setup.

Infosys — Jan 2024 - May 2025
Recruiter
Work mode: Onsite
- Conducted high-volume sourcing and screening for enterprise delivery roles using LinkedIn Recruiter, achieving 200+ candidate conversations and 40 offers across 16 months.
- Administered requisitions and candidate tracking in Workday, improving candidate-status accuracy from 82% to 96% through process updates and training.
- Supported payroll onboarding processes by verifying compensation components and collaborating with payroll teams to reduce data discrepancies by 40%.
- Engaged with Agile delivery leads and hiring panels to streamline interview loops, decreasing scheduling cycles by an average of 25%.

NimbusSoft — Aug 2019 - Dec 2023
Talent Acquisition Specialist
Work mode: Remote
- Owned end-to-end Recruitment for product and engineering teams, leveraging LinkedIn Recruiter to build talent pipelines that resulted in 120 offers and a 70% offer-acceptance rate over 4 years.
- Maintained candidate records and requisitions in Workday, executing quarterly audits that improved compliance and data hygiene to 98%.
- Coordinated with payroll and HR operations to onboard employees, resolving payroll setup issues for 100+ hires and reducing first-month errors by half.
- Collaborated with product owners and Agile teams using Jira-informed capacity planning to prioritize critical hires and support sprint staffing needs.

Projects
- Diversity Hiring Initiative: Designed targeted sourcing campaigns via LinkedIn Recruiter and community outreach that increased diverse candidate interview rates by 35% at NimbusSoft.
- Onboarding Workflow Optimization: Led a cross-functional mini-project at Infosys to align Workday workflows with payroll checkpoints, cutting new-hire onboarding time by one week on average.

Skills
Recruitment: Recruitment, Talent Acquisition, LinkedIn Recruiter, Workday
Operations: Payroll, Agile, Jira

Education
MBA (Marketing), IIM Indore
